instructions.name: openDca
expected_state_changes: creates a new DCA account with the schedule parameters from instruction data
transfers the input_amount from user_ata into the DCA escrow
risk_rules: user must be signer and the owner of user_ata
escrow transfer amount must equal data.input_amount
RISK: if escrow recipient is not the DCA program PDA, flag MaliciousAccountChange

instructions.name: openDcaV2
expected_state_changes: creates a new DCA account (v2 params: flexible interval configuration)
transfers the input_amount from user_ata into the DCA escrow
risk_rules: user must be signer and the owner of user_ata
escrow transfer amount must equal data.input_amount

instructions.name: closeDca
risk_rules: only the DCA owner may close
RISK: refund recipient must be accounts.user — if funds go elsewhere, flag CompositionalDrain

instructions.name: deposit
expected_state_changes: adds funds to the DCA escrow
risk_rules: only the DCA owner may deposit
deposit amount must match data.amount

instructions.name: withdraw
expected_state_changes: withdraws unswapped input tokens from the DCA escrow
risk_rules: only the DCA owner may withdraw
RISK: withdrawal recipient must be user_ata owned by accounts.user — flag if diverted

instructions.name: endAndClose
expected_state_changes: closes the DCA account and returns remaining escrow to the owner
risk_rules: only the DCA owner may end the schedule
RISK: refund recipient must be accounts.user

instructions.name: withdrawFees
expected_state_changes: transfers accumulated protocol fees from the fee vault to admin
risk_rules: admin-only instruction
RISK: unexpected fee withdrawal — flag PermissionEscalation

instructions.name: initiateFlashFill
expected_state_changes: keeper flash-borrows the DCA input position from in_ata to keeper_in_ata
records the borrow so fulfill_flash_fill must repay it
risk_rules: keeper-initiated flash fill must be repaid by a matching fulfill_flash_fill
RISK: borrowed input tokens must return to the DCA in_ata — if the repayment path is missing or diverted, flag FlashLoanAbuse

instructions.name: fulfillFlashFill
expected_state_changes: repays the flash loan into the DCA in_ata
executes the scheduled swap and credits output to the DCA out_ata
risk_rules: repay amount must equal the recorded borrow (keeper must not short-change the DCA)
RISK: swap output must land in the DCA out_ata — if diverted to the keeper or a third party, flag CompositionalDrain

instructions.name: transfer
expected_state_changes: keeper moves the DCA output from dca_out_ata to the owner's user_out_ata
risk_rules: transfer recipient must be the DCA owner's user_out_ata
RISK: if the output is diverted from the owner, flag CompositionalDrain

verification.discriminators_source: C22.4 re-verification (2026-08-09): deployed program confirmed standard Anchor (sha256("global:"+snake_case)[:8])
verification.notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-09: the previous discriminator table (ee26b3c8..., 459dd6dd..., etc.) was never observed on-chain — it was produced by base64-decoding base58 instruction data (the same decode artifact class as the Jupiter V6 C22.3 finding) and does not match the deployed program. On-chain census of real DCA txs (base58-correct decode) shows the deployed program is STANDARD ANCHOR: initiate_flash_fill=8fcd03bfa2d7f531, fulfill_flash_fill=7340e24e21d369a2, transfer=a334c8e78c0345ba all observed live; the remaining instructions follow the same snake_case convention (open_dca=2441b93601d264a3, open_dca_v2=8e772b6da2340bb1, close_dca=16072162a8b722f3, withdraw=b712469c946da122, deposit=f223c68952e1f2b6, withdraw_fees=c6d4ab6d90d7ae59, end_and_close=537da645f7fc6785). The three fill-path instructions (initiateFlashFill, fulfillFlashFill, transfer) were previously MISSING entirely — the dominant live DCA traffic (keeper fills) was falling to unknown-protocol mode; they are now declared.
